died.name: John Hancock
died.last_words: I shall look forward to a pleasant time.

died.name: Vittorio Alfieri
died.last_words: Clasp my hand, my dear friend, I die!

died.name: William Thomas Maxwell
died.cause: telling the Smith Gang to surrender prior to the Battleground Gunfight

died.name: Carlos Tafolla
died.cause: handing a silver dollar to posse member Henry Barrett after being mortally wounded in Battleground Gunfight
died.last_words: Give this to my wife. It, and the month's wages coming to me, will be all she will ever have.

died.name: Michael F. Farley
died.cause: The 58-year-old U.S. Representative and Gore–McLemore resolution supporter died of anthrax he contracted from his shaving brush.

died.name: Kathleen Ferrier
died.cause: to a nurse while dying of breast cancer
died.last_words: Wouldn't it be lovely if I could just go to sleep and not wake up again?

died.name: Clement Attlee
died.desc: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom
died.last_words: Hullo, Griff. How are you getting on?

born.name: Christian Friedrich Schwarz
born.last_words: Had it pleased my Lord to spare me longer I should have been glad. I should then have been able to speak yet a word to the sick and poor; but His will be done! May He, in mercy, but receive me! Into Thy hands I commend my spirit; Thou has redeemed me, O Thou faithful God.

born.name: Ma Barker
born.cause: to her son, Fred Barker, prior to their deaths in a shootout with the FBI

born.name: Friedrich Fromm
born.cause: prior to being executed as part of the post-conspiracy purge after the failure of the 20 July plot
born.last_words: I die, because it was ordered. I had always wanted only the best for Germany.
